doc.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002

title: His mother and the strip-show income
summary: His mother approved because the family was poor and the pay of 160 dollars a week helped.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Was your mother cool with you playing strip shows?
Well remember, we were fairly poor. And I’m the baby and so my sister had moved out by then and brother Charlie had moved out by then, and Michael was just about to move
out, and so bringing in a hundred sixty a week and a sophomore in high school helped out a lot. And I had my own car and things like that, I mean it was a pretty good situation.
